purpose: Canonical controller boundary for one serialized lifecycle and cascade transition.
rule: The state owner validates complete current lifecycle and cascade states, applies the paired transitions, validates the resulting states, and emits a bridge whose compact identities reference both resulting state digests. A caller cannot advance only one state machine through the canonical controller. Persistence stages all replacement artifacts before the ordered replacement; a host that requires crash-atomic multi-file publication must place this writer behind a single-directory or external transaction owner.
